transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We need to get the power-management plan sorted for tomorrow's 0800 to 1400 period. We've got three two-hour blocks available: 0800-1000, 1000-1200, and 1200-1400. The facilities shop, clinic, and protected-network section all need an approved block or operating control before the period begins. I'd like each section to present their requirements so we can work through this at the coordination board and I can approve the final plan. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Col. Harper, I need to flag something before we go further. I confirmed this morning that the east distribution panel must be taken offline for the generator load test from exactly 0800 to 1000. The electrical contractor's signed work sheet is in the facilities binder, but I have to admit it hasn't been added to the coordination-board slide yet. That means the facilities shop has a hard requirement on the 0800-1000 block.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Col. Harper, I need to add a clinic requirement to the board. I confirmed with our pharmacy technician that the clinic's vaccine refrigerator must remain on generator-backed power during the exact 1000-1200 block while its primary feed is transferred. This pharmacy note came in after yesterday's clinic report and hasn't been added to the base power plan yet. So the clinic has a hard requirement on the 1000-1200 block.
